```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# This report only ASSEMBLES already-computed outputs (cached .rds
# summaries already written to CSV, and PNGs already saved by
# lmnlfa_growth_sigmoid_staged.R) -- it never re-fits any Stan model, so
# rendering takes seconds, not hours. Re-run lmnlfa_growth_sigmoid_staged.R
# itself first if you want updated numbers; then re-knit this report.

data_dir <- Sys.getenv("DATA_DIR")
sshfs_data_dir <- "/private/tmp/sshfs/projects/abcd-projs/dissertation/study1/outputs"
if (!nzchar(data_dir) || !dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  if (dir.exists(sshfs_data_dir)) {
    data_dir <- sshfs_data_dir
  } else {
    root_path <- Sys.getenv("HOME_DIR")
    if (!nzchar(root_path)) root_path <- Sys.getenv("HOME")
    data_dir <- file.path(root_path, "projects/abcd-projs/dissertation/study1/outputs")
  }
}

model_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "lmnlfa_growth_sigmoid_staged")
trajectories_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "trajectories")
impact_comparisons_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "impact-comparisons")
dif_illustrations_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "dif-illustrations")
dif_selection_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "dif-selection")
pubertal_estimates_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "pubertal-estimates")

n_subsample <- params$n_subsample

# Emit a raw <img> tag directly via cat() rather than
# knitr::include_graphics() -- the latter's image-rendering only fires
# reliably as a chunk's own auto-printed return value, not when called
# from inside a hand-rolled results='asis' loop like the one below.
show_image <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; height:auto; margin-bottom:1.5em;" />\n\n',
      path
    ))
  } else {
    cat("_Not yet available:", basename(path), "_\n\n")
  }
}

# same reasoning as show_image() -- convert the kable to a raw HTML string
# and cat() it, rather than relying on print()/auto-print dispatch
show_table <- function(path, ...) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cat("_Not yet available:", basename(path), "_\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- read.csv(path)
  tbl_html <- kbl(df, digits = 3, ...) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    as.character()
  cat(tbl_html, "\n\n")
}

# pretty caption from a filename like
# "dif_illustration_peta_race_c2_female_n1500.png" -> "peta x race c2"
caption_from_file <- function(f, run_tag, prefix) {
  base <- sub("\\.png$", "", basename(f))
  base <- sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), "", base)
  base <- sub(paste0("_", run_tag, "$"), "", base)
  gsub("_", " ", base)
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (sx in c("female", "male")) {
  run_tag <- paste0(sx, "_n", n_subsample)

  cat("\n\n# ", tools::toTitleCase(sx), " (n = ", n_subsample, ")\n\n", sep = "")

  # NOTE: pattern must require an underscore immediately before run_tag --
  # "female_n1500" contains "male_n1500" as a literal substring, so a bare
  # pattern = run_tag would wrongly match female's files while listing
  # male's (and vice versa isn't an issue, but this direction is real).
  fits_exist <- length(list.files(file.path(model_dir, "fits"), pattern = paste0("_", run_tag, "\\.rds$"))) > 0
  if (!fits_exist) {
    cat("No cached fits found for this sex yet -- run `lmnlfa_growth_sigmoid_staged.R", sx, "` first.\n\n")
    next
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("## Growth Parameters (Stage C)\n\n")
  show_table(file.path(pubertal_estimates_dir, paste0("growth_params_", run_tag, ".csv")))

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n\n## Population Trajectory\n\n")
  show_image(file.path(trajectories_dir, paste0("mean_trajectory_", run_tag, ".png")))

  cat("\n\n### Individual Trajectories by Race\n\n")
  show_image(file.path(trajectories_dir, paste0("trajectories_by_race_", run_tag, ".png")))

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n\n## Growth-Curve Impact: Race + WtHR\n\n")
  cat("### Impact estimates, before vs. after separating DIF (Stage A vs. Stage C)\n\n")
  show_image(file.path(impact_comparisons_dir, paste0("impact_comparison_A_vs_C_", run_tag, ".png")))

  cat("\n\n### Trajectory by covariate, for significant impact terms\n\n")
  impact_files <- list.files(trajectories_dir, pattern = paste0("^impact_illustration_.*_", run_tag, "\\.png$"), full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(impact_files) == 0) {
    cat("No significant impact terms for this sex.\n\n")
  } else {
    for (f in impact_files) {
      cat("**", caption_from_file(f, run_tag, "impact_illustration"), "**\n\n", sep = "")
      show_image(f)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n\n## Differential Item Functioning (DIF)\n\n")
  cat("### DIF selection (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, q = .05, |effect| > .05)\n\n")
  show_image(file.path(dif_selection_dir, paste0("dif_selection_heatmap_", run_tag, ".png")))

  cat("\n\n<details><summary>Retained DIF terms as tables</summary>\n\n")
  cat("**Loading DIF retained**\n\n")
  show_table(file.path(dif_selection_dir, paste0("dif_selection_loading_", run_tag, ".csv")))
  cat("\n\n**Intercept DIF retained**\n\n")
  show_table(file.path(dif_selection_dir, paste0("dif_selection_intercept_", run_tag, ".csv")))
  cat("\n\n</details>\n\n")

  cat("\n\n### Item characteristic curves, by retained DIF cell\n\n")
  dif_files <- list.files(dif_illustrations_dir, pattern = paste0("^dif_illustration_.*_", run_tag, "\\.png$"), full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(dif_files) == 0) {
    cat("No retained DIF terms for this sex.\n\n")
  } else {
    for (f in dif_files) {
      cat("**", caption_from_file(f, run_tag, "dif_illustration"), "**\n\n", sep = "")
      show_image(f)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
